PREMIUM QUALITY - Each Tea Buddies tea filter is beautifully hand crafted with love and care to bring you the ultimate tea bag. Our tea filters are made with premium all natural fine grade paper specifically designed to brew the best cup of tea every time. Don’t worry about any added taste or color as our tea bags are unbleached with no added glues or staples.

QUICK & CONVENIENT - Simply pull out a loose tea filter from your Tea Buddies box, scoop your favorite loose leaf teas into the filter, and pull the drawstring closed. Take them to work, on the go, or traveling, they are a great buddy for all your favorite teas.

DRINK TEA WHILE HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT - Our landfills continue to fill and overflow as we use and dispose items that don't break down naturally. With Tea Buddies natural paper tea bags, you can be eco-friendly and help in the effort to preserve our good earth while also enjoying your favourite tea’s.
